profile.headline: Software Engineer @ DraftKings
profile.summary: I have a full-stack skillset, but particularly enjoy building robust, interactive, and data-intensive front-end experiences. I am currently a Software Engineer at DraftKings, where I work on the Pick6 web app and internal tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Plan feature work for the Pick6 web app and implement using a variety of technologies including Remix, React and TypeScript

Create and maintain New Relic dashboards using SQL-like language to convert unstructured event data into pertinent product health metrics, supporting observability and monitoring

Work cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to ensure product quality

positions.title: Software Design Externship
positions.description: Built self-hosted dashboard for monitoring an on-premises battery testing system

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Des Moines, Iowa, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed an ASP.NET web application to streamline workplace file management

Reduced average wait time for resource creation process by 50%

Participated in company hackathon to develop and present a project built using AWS serverless offerings

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Spring 2021 and Fall 2021: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures - CSCI 1933
Spring 2022: Machine Architecture and Organization - CSCI 2021

Hold office hours to help students clarify and reinforce class material

Produce practice materials and challenging computer science problems for students to complete as projects

Lead lab sessions by introducing supplementary exercises and helping students complete them

Answer students' questions through email and online discussion board

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Prototyped a cloud-based data visualization service using Python hosted on Google Cloud

Navigated a large Java code base to identify issues and implement features

Developed unit tests for RESTful APIs

Built a user-facing Python application to parse client data
